launch.template: -c "import os, subprocess, urllib.parse; db_type = os.environ['JMS_DB_TYPE']; host = os.environ['JMS_HOST']; port = os.environ['JMS_PORT']; database = os.environ.get('JMS_DATABASE', ''); username = os.environ['JMS_USERNAME']; password = os.environ.get('JMS_PASSWORD', ''); scheme = 'mysql' if db_type in ('mysql', 'mariadb') else 'postgresql' if db_type in ('postgresql', 'postgres') else None; (_ for _ in ()).throw(SystemExit(f'unsupported database type: {db_type}')) if scheme is None else None; user = urllib.parse.quote(username, safe=''); passwd = urllib.parse.quote(password, safe=''); db = urllib.parse.quote(database, safe=''); url = f'{scheme}://{user}:{passwd}@{host}:{port}/{db}'; subprocess.run(['open', url], check=True)"
